note: Lengths are {"in": x} or {"mm": x}; the loader accepts either. A shop override file with the same name in %APPDATA%\SwAgent\tools\builtin-data\design-compression-mold\ is merged key by key.

flash.lipCornerRule: min(0.25 in, cavity corner R + lip)
flash.seams: runners leave only through the assembled outer edge, may cross a seam at 90 deg, never run along one (>= 0.25 in); seam edges not filleted

dowels.schemeNote: critique D1: one round dowel plus the others slotted along radial lines from it (or round + diamond + two relieved). Confirm against how the shop's existing 4 dowels are fitted before overriding the shop standard.

chamfer.where: base bottom outer edges and lid top outer edges

handles.rule: outside the platen outline, or wholly below the lid's platen face (critique D2, acceptance A16)

pour.note: critique D3: t_pour per cavity = charge / mass rate + handling time

slideIn.note: critique E4: a positive stop lands the mold centred under the ram every cycle (makes S8 true)

machining.finishDefault: as machined, 1.6 um Ra on cavity faces unless the drawing says otherwise
